item.title: Oil and gas prices rapidly rise as Iran war shows no signs of letting up
item.description: The price of oil surged higher and showed no signs of halting its rapid climb a week after the U.S. and Israel launched major attacks on Iran that escalated into a war in the Middle East.

item.title: Jan. 6 plaque honoring police officers is now displayed at the Capitol after a 3-year delay
item.description: The Washington Post first reported the installation of the plaque, which was witnessed by a reporter about 4 a.m. EST Saturday. It is the first official marker of the violent day in the Capitol.

item.title: Man found guilty of role in 2023 fatal shooting, faces up to 137 years
item.description: These charges stem from the September 2023 fatal shooting of Ayvion Parker, who was found at the scene with multiple gunshot wounds, with his younger brother next to him, who had been shot in the leg.

item.title: Neighbors voice concerns over proposed quarry near IU Health campus in Fort Wayne
